shared_elements: shallow relief carving of motifs on a flat surface
circular or disc-like motif (rosettes in A, rings in B)
justification: The only correspondences are generic: both surfaces bear low-relief carving including circular/disc-like motifs and some reference to the human form. A shows a narrative frieze of profile human figures leading horned animals past a stylised tree above a rosette border, while B shows an abstract arrangement of rings, arcs and bands on the back of a three-dimensional anthropomorphic monolith, with no narrative, no animals and no profile figures.
